note: The RC-9A debt manifest (ratified 2026-08-28, consolidated at the S0-8 regeneration). Every property Stage 0 defers to a later gate is exactly one entry here; a gate consults this file and blocks while its debt is unpaid, expired or input-changed; an entry leaves only by a payment record or a recorded waiver; what-blocks-what is computed from these entries on demand (pnpm debts), never transcribed beside them. Read back by scripts/check-debts.mjs (pnpm debts:check, in pnpm check) and consumed by scripts/check-traceability.mjs for its owed rows. Inputs are pinned by hash12 of the file, or of the named section under the authority-map slicing rule; a changed input fails the check until the entry is re-read and re-pinned or amended. The 2026-09-08 storage amendment adds three unpaid production-conformance obligations; earlier repaired finding statuses and primitive receipts do not pay them.

debts.property: The known old-origin plaintext cutover as one resumable transaction — export, import, active-store selection, deletion, restart — with its kill matrix executed against a seeded legacy installation. The terminal-state rule is the finding's own validation procedure, step 3: after each kill and restart, recovery reaches either a verified pre-cutover state with the legacy carrier preserved, or one verified encrypted post-cutover state; recognizable plaintext is absent from every carrier once cutover completes. Preserved legacy plaintext before completion is the finding's allowed recoverable state, not a residue failure.
debts.artifact: the executed kill matrix over the cutover state machine, run against a seeded legacy installation — never the live first deployment, which is Stage 2's — with a residue scan at every kill point and the reached terminal state named at each
debts.falsifier: a kill point whose restart reaches neither terminal state, a completed cutover leaving recognizable plaintext in any carrier, or a resume that can neither complete nor roll back, fails the matrix; a residue scan that fails on plaintext preserved before completion is reading the wrong rule and does not pay the debt either; design prose without an executed matrix is refused as payment

debts.property: The provenance residue after the S0-8 header binding: reproducible rebuild — the same bytes from the same source under a pinned or attested toolchain — with blob attestation. The toolchain-free source↔blob drift binding landed in wasm:verify and detects drift, never forgery; a builder that lies about hashes, or a compromised toolchain, is exactly this residue.
debts.artifact: an attested reproduction: pinned toolchain identity, the rebuilt blob's hash equal to the shipped hash, and the attestation binding them
debts.falsifier: a green KAT, or the drift binding itself, cannot mark this paid — the payment is a reproduced build under a pinned toolchain, receipted; anything less is refused
